answers.core: This is really common functionality that practically every game wants to use. Taking screens without the HUD as well as pointing a 3D cursor on a terrain are really common use cases. It makes sense to provide a high-level abstraction to simplify this especially for novices.
answers.workaround: The work arounds right now are really hacky. You have to use viewports and wait for post frame or write a lot of boilerplate low level code.

title: Add high-level ScreenCopyNode and DepthCopyNode helpers
